C0951.title: Supreme People's Procuratorate Article Analyzes Gambling Governance in Live-Streaming Probability Games
C0951.summary: In January 2026, the Supreme People's Procuratorate website published an article on accurately distinguishing conduct in live-streaming gambling governance. It analyzed the common model of platform-led or deeply involved gambling operations, guild implementation, and probability-based gameplay forming a recharge, betting, and cash-out loop, while stressing the need to distinguish gambling crimes from normal entertainment.

references.title: Accurately Distinguishing the Nature of Acts to Effectively Govern Online Live-Streaming Gambling
